style_base: Hand drawn warm watercolor illustration, soft ink pen lines, paper texture, exaggerated caricature characters with comedic expressions, warm earth-tone pastel colors, information-dense editorial style, humorous friendly mood, countries shown via clothing plus flag badge. Exactly one large legible Korean Hangul phrase (2 to 5 characters) on the main banner; every other board, panel and chart shows ONLY numbers, percentages, arrows and charts — no English words, no other text of any kind.
cut_rule: Minimum 3 seconds per image cut. Subtitle segments under 3s are merged with a neighbor so each image spans >= 3s. SRT stays 14 lines; images = 8 cuts.
source: intro_synced_v2.srt (14 segments merged into 8 image cuts, ~41.6s)
